title: Reach Over the Wall
setup: Game 1 of the 1996 ALCS. Bottom of the eighth, and the Yankees trail the Orioles 4-3. Derek Jeter lifts a deep fly ball to right field. Orioles right fielder Tony Tarasco sets up at the wall, and a fan in the stands reaches over and touches the ball.
question: What does right-field umpire Rich Garcia rule?
options: Fan interference. Jeter is out and the Orioles keep the lead.
Ground-rule double. Jeter stops at second.
Home run. The game is tied 4-4.
ruling: Garcia ruled it a home run, tying the game 4-4. Tarasco and manager Davey Johnson protested that a fan had touched the ball, and Johnson was ejected. American League president Gene Budig denied the Orioles' protest. The Yankees won in the 11th on a Bernie Williams home run and took the series 4-1.
rulebookNote: The source says the protest was denied because judgment calls cannot be protested.
